title: 09. Production & Safety: Output Guardrails
summary: Even after validation, LLMs can generate harmful, biased, inaccurate, or off-brand content. Output guardrails check the LLM's response before sending it to the user.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Even after validation, LLMs can generate **harmful, biased, inaccurate, or off-brand** content. Output guardrails check the **LLM's response** before sending it to the user.

sections.title: Output Guardrails Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              OUTPUT GUARDRAILS — WHAT TO CHECK                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  GUARDRAIL 1: HARMFUL CONTENT
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Block outputs containing:
  • Instructions for making weapons
  • Content exploiting minors
  • Detailed self-harm instructions
  • Incitement to violence
  → Use OpenAI Moderation API or custom classifier

  GUARDRAIL 2: PII IN OUTPUT
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LLM might include user data from context in response.
  Scan output for:
  • Email addresses
  • Phone numbers
  • Credit card numbers
  • Social security numbers
  • Passwords/API keys
  → Mask before returning to user

  GUARDRAIL 3: HALLUCINATION DETECTION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Check if LLM answer is grounded in retrieved context.
  If LLM says "X costs $500" but context says "X costs $200"
  → Flag as potential hallucination
  → Return lower confidence answer or ask for clarification

  GUARDRAIL 4: BRAND SAFETY
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  For business deployments:
  • Does response recommend competitors? Block.
  • Does response make unsupported claims? Flag.
  • Does response use approved tone/language? Check.
  • Does response stay in scope? Verify.

  GUARDRAIL 5: FACTUAL CONSISTENCY
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Compare key facts in response against retrieved docs:
  Numbers, dates, names, versions → must match sources.
  Contradiction detected → regenerate or add disclaimer.

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  GUARDRAIL PIPELINE:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  LLM Response
       │
       ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │  1. Harmful content?    │── YES → Block + log
  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │ NO
            ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │  2. PII in response?    │── YES → Mask PII → continue
  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │ NO/Masked
            ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │  3. Hallucination risk? │── HIGH → Add disclaimer
  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │ LOW
            ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────┐
  │  4. Brand/scope check?  │── FAIL → Regenerate
  └─────────┬───────────────┘
            │ PASS
            ▼
     Safe Response ✅
```
